description: Inspect Healthchecks.io checks and monitoring information for scheduled jobs. Use status and monitoring information to prepare incident reviews, on-call handoffs, and follow-up work. Relate returned states to event timing, affected resources, and your own monitoring records to identify areas that need further investigation. A status result generally covers a particular check or component and should not replace end-to-end validation of the business service.
description_cn: 查询 Healthchecks.io 检查项及定时任务监控信息。适合集中整理可用性事件、监控检查和处理进展，辅助值班交接及问题复盘。可将返回状态与事件时间、受影响对象和自身监控记录关联，判断需要进一步检查的环节。状态信息通常只反映特定检查范围，不能替代端到端的业务可用性验证。
